text:
You need an Amazon PPC specialist who can set up and optimize campaigns, conduct keyword research, and use data analysis to improve sales.  

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I can help you structure campaigns, monitor performance, and turn the data into clear optimization actions.  

In a marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I built a BigQuery model joining ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in SQL to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. As a result, 18% of ad budget was reallocated and customer acquisition cost fell 12% the next quarter.  

I’d bring the same data-driven approach to your Amazon PPC campaigns: keyword research, performance monitoring, and practical recommendations to improve sales.
